<!--
================================================================================
  GOAL
  ----
  Compare the cluster assignments produced by Probabilistic Distance (PD)
  clustering against those from Factorial Probabilistic Distance (FPDC)
  clustering, for the same set of MovieLens 1M user embeddings and the same
  values of k. The primary comparison metric is the Adjusted Rand Index (ARI),
  which measures agreement between two partitions on a scale of –1 (worse than
  chance) to 1 (perfect agreement), correcting for chance-level overlap.

  HOW IT WORKS
  ------------
  1. Settings  – Define the embedding paths, the k values to compare, and the
                 q range used when FPDC was originally fitted.
  2. Helpers   – Two loader functions isolate cache-reading logic:
                   • load_cached_pd_for_k()       – loads a PD result for a
                     given (embedding, k) from output/pd_cache/.
                   • load_best_cached_fpdc_for_k() – scans all cached q values
                     for a given (embedding, k), returns the (k, q) pair with
                     the highest Silhouette (CH as tiebreaker).
  3. Main loop – For each (embedding, k) pair, load both PD and FPDC labels,
                 verify they cover the same number of users, compute ARI via
                 mclust::adjustedRandIndex(), and record per-method quality
                 metrics alongside the ARI value.
  4. Output    – Bind all rows into a single summary data frame, print it, and
                 write it to output/pd_fpdc_ari_results/ari_pd_vs_fpdc_summary.csv.
  5. Contingency – A focused chunk loads labels for one specific (embedding, k)
                 pair and prints a cross-tabulation of PD vs. FPDC cluster
                 assignments to show where the two methods agree or disagree.
================================================================================
-->

```{r ari-pd-vs-fpdc}
# Install any missing packages before loading them
required_packages <- c("readr", "dplyr", "mclust")
installed         <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs      <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(mclust)  # provides adjustedRandIndex()
```

```{r settings}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Embedding files to compare across; must match those used when running the
# FPDC and PD clustering notebooks
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

# k values to compare; constrained to what was cached by the FPDC notebook
k_to_compare <- c(2, 3, 4, 5)   # FPDC was only cached for k = 2:5
q_range      <- 2:4              # FPDC q-range from the clustering notebook

dir.create("output/pd_fpdc_ari_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load a cached PD result for one (embedding_tag, k) combination.
# Returns NULL if the cache file is not found.
load_cached_pd_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val,
                                 cache_dir = "output/pd_cache") {

  cache_file <- file.path(
    cache_dir,
    paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds")
  )

  if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  readRDS(cache_file)
}

# Load the best cached FPDC result for one (embedding_tag, k) combination.
# Searches across all q values and selects the one with the highest Silhouette
# (Calinski-Harabasz used as a tiebreaker). Returns NULL if nothing is found.
load_best_cached_fpdc_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val, q_vals = 2:4,
                                        cache_dir = "output/fpdc_cache") {

  candidates <- list()

  for (q_val in q_vals) {
    cache_file <- file.path(
      cache_dir,
      paste0("fpdc_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )

    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)

      candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
        k        = k_val,
        q        = q_val,
        model    = cached$model,
        silhouette = cached$Silhouette,
        ch       = cached$CH,
        prob_silh = cached$ProbSilh,
        file     = cache_file
      )
    }
  }

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Build a data frame of candidate metrics for easy ordering
  candidate_df <- bind_rows(lapply(candidates, function(x) {
    data.frame(
      q          = x$q,
      Silhouette = x$silhouette,
      CH         = x$ch,
      ProbSilh   = x$prob_silh
    )
  }))

  # Select the candidate with the highest Silhouette; CH breaks ties
  best_idx <- with(candidate_df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
  candidates[[best_idx]]
}
```

```{r main}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN LOOP
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ari_results <- list()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {

  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing embedding file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }

  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_tag, "\n")

  for (k_val in k_to_compare) {
    cat("  Comparing PD vs FPDC for k =", k_val, "\n")

    # ----------------------------
    # Load PD labels for this (embedding, k)
    # ----------------------------
    pd_cached <- load_cached_pd_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val         = k_val,
      cache_dir     = "output/pd_cache"
    )

    if (is.null(pd_cached)) {
      cat("    Missing PD cache for k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }

    # ----------------------------
    # Load best FPDC labels for the same (embedding, k)
    # ----------------------------
    fpdc_cached <- load_best_cached_fpdc_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val         = k_val,
      q_vals        = q_range,
      cache_dir     = "output/fpdc_cache"
    )

    if (is.null(fpdc_cached)) {
      cat("    Missing FPDC cache for k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }

    # ----------------------------
    # Extract hard cluster labels
    # ----------------------------
    pd_labels   <- pd_cached$labels
    fpdc_labels <- fpdc_cached$model$label

    # Safety check: both methods must have labelled the same number of users
    if (length(pd_labels) != length(fpdc_labels)) {
      cat("    Label length mismatch for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }

    # ----------------------------
    # Compute Adjusted Rand Index
    # ----------------------------
    # ARI = 1 means perfect agreement; 0 means chance-level agreement
    ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(pd_labels, fpdc_labels)

    # Record per-method quality metrics alongside the ARI for easy comparison
    ari_results[[length(ari_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      embedding         = embedding_tag,
      k                 = k_val,
      fpdc_best_q       = fpdc_cached$q,
      pd_silhouette     = pd_cached$avg_silhouette,
      pd_ch             = pd_cached$ch,
      pd_prob_silh      = pd_cached$prob_silh,
      fpdc_silhouette   = fpdc_cached$silhouette,
      fpdc_ch           = fpdc_cached$ch,
      fpdc_prob_silh    = fpdc_cached$prob_silh,
      ari               = ari_val,
      pd_cluster_sizes  = paste(as.integer(table(pd_labels)),   collapse = "|"),
      fpdc_cluster_sizes = paste(as.integer(table(fpdc_labels)), collapse = "|"),
      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

```{r final}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Combine all per-(embedding, k) rows and sort for readability
ari_results_df <- bind_rows(ari_results) %>%
  arrange(embedding, k)

print(ari_results_df)

# Persist the full comparison table for reporting and further analysis
write.csv(
  ari_results_df,
  file      = file.path("output/pd_fpdc_ari_results", "ari_pd_vs_fpdc_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r pd-fpdc-contingency-table}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# -------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# Change these two values to inspect a different (embedding, k) pair.
# -------------------------------
embedding_tag <- "user_embeddings_128"   # which embedding to inspect
k_val         <- 3                       # which k to inspect
q_range       <- 2:4

# -------------------------------
# HELPERS
# Focused loaders that raise an error rather than returning NULL,
# since this chunk is meant to be run interactively for a specific case.
# -------------------------------

# Load hard cluster labels from a PD cache file
load_pd_labels <- function(embedding_tag, k_val) {
  file <- file.path("output/pd_cache",
                    paste0("pd_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(file)) stop("Missing PD cache")
  readRDS(file)$labels
}

# Load hard cluster labels from the best FPDC cache file (highest Silhouette)
load_best_fpdc_labels <- function(embedding_tag, k_val, q_vals = 2:4) {
  candidates <- list()

  for (q_val in q_vals) {
    file <- file.path("output/fpdc_cache",
                      paste0("fpdc_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds"))

    if (file.exists(file)) {
      cached <- readRDS(file)
      candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
        q      = q_val,
        sil    = cached$Silhouette,
        ch     = cached$CH,
        labels = cached$model$label
      )
    }
  }

  if (length(candidates) == 0) stop("No FPDC cache found")

  # Select the best q for this k by Silhouette then CH
  df       <- bind_rows(lapply(candidates, function(x) {
    data.frame(q = x$q, Silhouette = x$sil, CH = x$ch)
  }))
  best_idx <- with(df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
  candidates[[best_idx]]$labels
}

# -------------------------------
# LOAD LABELS
# -------------------------------
pd_labels   <- load_pd_labels(embedding_tag, k_val)
fpdc_labels <- load_best_fpdc_labels(embedding_tag, k_val, q_range)

# -------------------------------
# BUILD CONTINGENCY TABLE
# Rows = PD clusters, Columns = FPDC clusters.
# High off-diagonal counts indicate users assigned to different clusters by
# each method, while diagonal counts reflect agreement.
# -------------------------------
cont_table <- table(
  PD   = factor(pd_labels),
  FPDC = factor(fpdc_labels)
)

# -------------------------------
# PRINT TABLE
# -------------------------------
cont_table
```
